scope: Original AnimationPack.Read, sample-state constructor 0x1000e42d0 and whole sample wrapper 0x1000e6900/sampler 0x1000e5020 with retarget=false. Exact weights, frame/clip indices, loop flag, all XYZ/quaternion pose bytes are compared; unused position/scale SIMD lanes normalized to zero. Allocation and absent AnimationList are explicit services. Retargeting, animation-clock/blending, bone matrices, skinning and creature ownership/drawing remain separate.
